snippet.title: Cat Squeeze release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Cat Squeeze is a cozy, brain-teasing cat puzzle game. Playing as an explosive kitten, use the extrusion of the pipeline, and navigate a maze to collect fish treats! Solve puzzles with precise blasts to escape, or get trapped by the soft maze.

Cat Squeeze by Cattery Studio and @PoneGamesStudio  is releasing July 1st, 2026!

Cat Squeeze in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/cat-squeeze/
Cat Squeeze on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549280/Bulbos_Belief_System/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
